Entry selection checks zero parameters, safe signature and u32 result before emission; syntax/name/type/unsupported/entry and UTF-8 errors are surfaced.

Publication uses create_new temporary file, writes complete bytes, sets mode and syncs before rename; failures remove owned temporary files. Unix inode/device comparison rejects existing source aliases.
Source list and every metrics hash/physical count independently verified. Runtime/publication/CLI included in own code; lexer/source/diagnostic included once; Unicode and tests explicitly separate.

limitations: Acceptance is for bounded single-file Core S B0/B1 prototype, not complete R1a or self-hosting.
No comprehensive recursion/time/memory adversarial hardening or concurrent hostile pathname-race protection is claimed or verified.
Linux low-eight-bit process exit is insufficient to disambiguate arbitrary normal return 101 from panic; controlled fixtures establish panic paths.
External Cargo dependencies are excluded from handwritten source totals and required for seed compiler build; generated target executables have no libc/toolchain dependency.
